status.description: done = task finished and its test passes; blocked = needs an answer from the user; failed = could not finish

summary.description: What was changed and why, specific (files, functions)

files_changed.description: Project-relative paths of every file created, edited or deleted

result.description: The actual output summary, e.g. '12 passed'

tests_run.description: null only when blocked before any test could run

question.description: The question for the user, with your recommendation

tried.description: What you checked or attempted before stopping

blocker.description: Required when status is blocked or failed; null when done
